subject_definitions:
The guide video is the source of the edit. In it, each subject to replace is marked with its surface-normal map colorized in one solid color (its 3D surface, without its real colors); the mark says who changes, not where the new look must end, and everything else in the guide is the real video.
<Subject 1> is the subject marked by the red normal map in the guide video; its appearance comes from <Picture 1>, its pose and motion from the red mark.
<Subject 2> is the subject marked by the blue normal map in the guide video; its appearance comes from <Picture 2>, its pose and motion from the blue mark.
summary: [video editing + reference generation] The target video is the guide video with the red subject replaced by <Picture 1>, the blue subject replaced by <Picture 2>, from the first frame to the last, following each mark's pose and motion. Every other person, the layout, the backgrounds, the camera and the motion stay exactly as in the guide video. Keep held objects and foreground occluders in their original positions, shapes and colors; they are separate from the subject being replaced.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: attribute_transfer - keeps the pose and motion of the red mark and takes the face, hair, body and whole outfit of <Picture 1> in every frame.
<Subject 2>: attribute_transfer - keeps the pose and motion of the blue mark and takes the face, hair, body and whole outfit of <Picture 2> in every frame.
Everyone else, held objects, foreground occluders, the layout and the backgrounds: fully_preserved.

# H3 Studio export: 02b_h3_character_swap_marked

Generated by h3studio/wf_h3swap.py (do not edit by hand; run `python3 wf_h3swap.py` in h3studio/).
